name: Bestial Transformation
description: Enchanted carvings of animals transform any creatures who damage the door into the animal they harmed.
disable: DC 26 Nature check (expert) to handle the animal carvings or DC 33 Thievery check (master) to scratch out the animal carvings or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the spell

offensiveAbilities.name: Animal Form
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature damages the door

Effect The trap casts Bestial Curse on the triggering creature (DC 32 Fortitude save); on a critical failure, the duration is 2 hours.
